board: opening book, seed 4000, before the headline
unit: US Ops, from the US seat: positive is good for the US, a USSR event is negative. The bot's values are converted with its own Ops scale (ops_value), interpolated.

Marshall_Plan.note: 3 battleground points (WG/Italy cushions, France's first step) >= 2 Ops; 4 non-BG points + NATO ~1 Op. Measured on the wrong board: holding it you spread the opening.

Suez_Crisis.note: Knocks the US out of the Middle East (Israel), Europe domination replacement, UK repair. Above Arab-Israeli War.

Romanian_Abdication.note: Nothing until the USSR has the Europe battleground lead.

Truman_Doctrine.note: Near zero on the opening board?

De_Stalinization.note: Empty board to Thailand + Angola + Chile + Venezuela is easily 12 Mid War VP even if Thailand gets couped (counter-coup with China). Call it 7 Ops.

Socialist_Governments.note: Replacement is ~3 Ops, and against any play the USSR either coups Italy at 1 or takes it free and forces the US to coup back (~0.5 Op).

De_Gaulle_Leads_France.note: Against an empty France: the adjacency.

Vietnam_Revolts.note: A ton on an empty Thailand; much, much weaker once the US has adjacency or control there.

Blockade.note: Weird: its whole value is the reshuffle and it depends on the opponent's hand, which MCTS will struggle to value. Call it an Op either way.

NATO.note: Activating Special Relationship is worth about 1 Op. Table says 0: flag-only events are a known gap.

Containment.note: Very strong headline. Number of Ops it affects: the cards you will actually play this turn (action rounds, not hand size). Bot's 3.5 is within range; 4 is closer.

Red_Scare_Purge.note: Very strong headline: 5-6 Ops at the start of the turn, falling linearly with every card the opponent has already played (and you may have more important cards to play). 1-Op cards are unaffected. Can also be played for its 4 Ops. Symmetric card: the US seat's view is the value of the US playing it.

Five_Year_Plan.note: Solely the event value of hitting the USSR with Marshall / US-Japan / Containment; not worth a lot.

Nuclear_Test_Ban.note: About an Op as an event, though you would never event it.

Olympic_Games.note: Bot's 0.29 accepted: the opponent participates, sponsor rolls +2, winner takes 2 VP, about 0.9 VP expected to the sponsor.

Indo_Pakistani_War.note: A bit more than the bot's 0.29 for the military Ops and the VP, but within range.

Captured_Nazi_Scientist.note: Double space plus the extra VP.

Defectors.note: Strong in the headline (cancels the USSR headline, +1 VP), cannot be played for the event. Unpriced.

NORAD.note: 0.5 to 1.5 Ops: not much, but something. Table says 0.

UN_Intervention.note: A whole thing: nullifies the opponent's event, like spacing a card but stronger with high-Ops cards (Marshall, US/Japan). Hand-dependent; unpriced.

The_Cambridge_Five.note: Only matters if it hits an opposing scoring card. About an Op either way.

footholds._note: The US Ops the country's current US position is worth on the opening board (country_value from the US seat, converted).

Israel.note: At least an Op: the only Middle East position, Egypt then Libya.

Japan.note: Below the Philippines: US/Japan exists and South Korea is already held; worth something only as insurance for losing South Korea.

Iran.note: Table says the most valuable US country, above controlled West Germany, for Pakistan/Afghanistan/India reach.

placement_rank._note: Rank the battlegrounds a seat can place a first Op into on the opening board, best first. Every pair out of the bot's order counts as a miss. Bot's order at 6cf91c7 is in _bot_US / _bot_USSR for reference.
